title: The dance over the river
summary: Bull says the new dance across the river had a good crowd and more life than the bands in the hall.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: And what is that dance like over the river?

Well, it was good last week. Very good. It's the first week it had been on. They had a good crowd. It looks as though it's going to kick on. And the band played very well. It's sort of had a bit more life than it does in the hall sometimes. You know, the bands in the hall tend to get a little bit dead, complacent or something. I don't know. But over there they had a bit more life to it. It was going well. Very good.
